authority.source: owner task of 2026-10-11: research and plan a sustainable test strategy; keep the 20-minute shard timeout; additional shards, concurrency and nightly moves are not the long-term answer; design a practical cost reduction and a continuing maintenance process. Amended the same day: staged move toward affected tests plus critical journeys before merging, batched full E2E on pinned main commits with a 60-minute operational target and recorded landing ranges, selection safety before reducing full-run frequency, evidence rules that preserve named behaviours rather than counts, budgets based on measured headroom and a fixed envelope with narrow expiring exceptions, maintenance as completed weekly work; implement in small independently verified phases through /queue-merge
